headline_hook: Open Weights Hit Their Kubernetes Moment as Opus 5 Halves the Frontier Price

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Open-weight AI crossing from 'interesting alternative' to 'default infrastructure' follows the exact Kubernetes playbook — and history says once that threshold is crossed, the proprietary incumbents don't lose market share gradually, they lose it all at once in specific segments.

model_literacy.relevance: Opus 5 achieving Fable-level performance at half the cost is a distillation story — a smaller model trained to replicate a larger model's behavior. Understanding distillation explains why frontier performance keeps getting cheaper and why today's premium tier becomes tomorrow's default.
